short: The United States abandoned its neutrality and declared war on Germany, shifting the balance of global power.
full:
On 6 April 1917, the United States Congress formally declared war on the German Empire. President Woodrow Wilson had requested the declaration following Germany's resumption of unrestricted submarine warfare and the revelation of the Zimmermann Telegram, which proposed a German-Mexican alliance against the US.

The American entry transformed the conflict. Though it took months to mobilize and deploy the American Expeditionary Forces in large numbers, the promise of inexhaustible American manpower and industrial capacity shattered German morale. The financial and material backing of the US bolstered the exhausted Allied powers and definitively tipped the scales toward their eventual victory.
